topic: Mapping Protein Structures with Machine Learning
caption: For decades, determining the 3D structure of proteins took years of painstaking laboratory work. Today, machine learning models like AlphaFold are helping researchers predict these complex molecular shapes in minutes. By analyzing vast databases of known amino acid sequences, algorithms uncover structural patterns invisible to the human eye. This computational acceleration is transforming how scientists approach drug design and biochemistry. How might instant structural data change the timeline of modern pharmacology? #ArtificialIntelligence #StructuralBiology #ScientificResearch #MachineLearning #Biotech
